Custom bullet character for unordered lists

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<ul><li>Item A</li><li>Item B</li></ul>", new ConversionOptions { Bullets = "*" });
Console.WriteLine(result);
```
